query: UPDATE workspaces SET status='active', updated_at=? WHERE id=? AND kind IN ('workspace','fork') AND status='archived' AND (parent_workspace_id IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspaces parent WHERE parent.id=workspaces.parent_workspace_id AND parent.status='active')) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM projects WHERE projects.id=workspaces.project_id AND projects.status='active')
